citation: Kedlian VR, Wang Y, Liu T, Chen X, Bolt L, et al. (2024). Human skeletal muscle aging atlas. Nature Aging 4:727-744.
design: pseudo-bulk limma-voom ~ age_group + modality (sc vs sn)
comparison: Aged (60-75) vs Young (20-30), per cell type
batch_correction: scRNA vs snRNA modality included as covariate
limitations: Aged group 60-75y is YOUNGER than Lai HLMA's 74-99 — captures EARLY-to-MID aging, not advanced sarcopenia. Only 8-9 donors per group; gene-level differential underpowered. Pathway-level GSEA preferred.
role_in_consensus: Per-cell-type resolution for v2.per_cell_type sub-blocks. Primary single-cell source. Live h5ad backs local_atlas_query for receptor expression queries (Step 1b).
